title: Make Edit/Delete Record dialog body reliably scrollable for long pickup lists and forms

requirements.summary: Adjust Edit/Delete Record dialog layout so the pickup list and edit form scroll within the dialog (desktop/mobile) without scrolling the page behind it.
acceptanceCriteria: With a day containing enough pickups to exceed one screen height, the pickup list inside the Edit/Delete Record dialog is scrollable and the last pickup can be reached and clicked.
When editing a pickup, if the edit form exceeds the dialog height, the form content is scrollable and the Save/Delete/Cancel controls remain reachable via scrolling.
Scrolling works on both desktop and mobile-sized viewports without the page behind the dialog scrolling instead of the dialog content.
No regression: selecting a pickup still transitions into the edit form without blank screens or runtime errors.

file_operations.description: Fix dialog scrolling by adjusting layout composition (without changing shadcn UI internals): ensure the DialogContent uses a constrained height and a flex column layout with a dedicated scrollable body region that has `min-h-0`, remove/avoid nested conflicting overflow settings, and make the pickup list and edit form scroll areas take the available height so touch/trackpad scrolling stays inside the dialog on mobile/desktop. Use the shadcn-ui Dialog and ScrollArea components as currently imported to support the scrollable dialog body behavior (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
